channel.title: POOPIEMATE stories and guides
channel.description: Stories and dog guides from POOPIEMATE, the dog potty log your whole family shares

item.title: Two Working Parents? How to Never Miss a Dog Walk or Mix Up Whose Turn It Is
item.description: For dual-income homes: keep dog walk times on track and stop mixing up whose turn it is by seeing who walked the dog and when.

item.title: Jindo Mix Potty Training: Why Does It Feel So Hard?
item.description: Jindo mixes are smart and independent, so knowing their outdoor potty pattern matters most. Breed traits, training tips and how to keep a log.

item.title: Raising Multiple Dogs? How to Keep Their Potty Logs Straight
item.description: In a multi-dog home it's easy to lose track of whose poop is whose. Log each dog in its own profile and share it with your family.

item.title: How to Track Potty for a Dog Who Only Goes Outside
item.description: With an outdoor-only dog, only the walker knows if they went. Log it right after the walk and share it with your family in the app.

item.title: Healthy Dog Poop: What Good Poop Looks Like, and What Poop Color Means
item.description: What healthy dog poop looks like, and what texture and color (gray, black, bloody, green) can mean, including diarrhea color and when to see a vet.

item.title: How Often Should a Dog Poop? Daily Potty Count and Intervals
item.description: How many times a day puppies, adult and senior dogs poop, what a normal potty interval is, and when to talk to a vet.

item.title: How to Share Your Dog's Potty Log with Family in Real Time
item.description: Skip the chat screenshots and notes. Share your dog's poop, pee and walk records with the whole family in real time, with one tap in the free POOPIEMATE app.

item.title: What Is a Dog Walk Safety Index? Is It Safe to Walk Today?
item.description: Check if today's walk is safe on a 1 to 5 scale from feels-like temperature, chance of rain and your dog's size, age and coat. Plus summer and winter tips.

item.title: From developer to solo builder: the POOPIEMATE story
item.description: Leaving ComfyUI and building POOPIEMATE alone, from design and code to store reviews and marketing: 120 first users, then the 2.0.0 family care app.

item.title: Why I built POOPIEMATE
item.description: The dog we first saw on a rescue group’s Instagram, and the “Did she poop?” calls we made every single day.
